Hey everyone!

In preparation for the Retro Game event for Doom II this weekend, I decided to write up a guide on how to get setup so you can connect and join.

Windows Setup Guide

Before we begin, you'll need to download a copy of Zandronum 2.0 and DoomSeeker:

  • Zandronum 2.0 for Windows

The bundled install above contains both Zandronum 2.0 and DoomSeeker. Once the install is finished, go to the folder you installed Zandronum to and add a folder named "wads". Remember the file path for your wads folder.

Once you've finished the install, download the following and extract into your wads folder:

  • Freedoom 1 and 2
  • UDMX Deathmatch Map Pack
  • BrutalDoom v19EE

Once you've got the files extracted into your wad folder, back to the main Zandronum folder and look for a folder named 'DoomSeeker'. Go into it and run Doomseeker.exe. You'll be presented with the main server window.

All we need to do now is configure DoomSeeker. Go to the Options menu and click Configure.

  • Make sure that under Engines -> Zandronum that the 'Path to Executable' option is pointing to your Zandronum executable

  • Make sure that under File Paths, your wad directory that you created earlier is on the list to the right

Once you've done all this, you can go back to the main server window. In the Search box (upper right hand corner), type in PikachuInTheShower and you should see our server come up.

Anyone with Level Authentication Failed or Protected Lump Authentication Failed: Please verify that your wad directory has these three files. Most of the time, these errors are because the required WAD files are missing, or your WAD directory is not in the File Paths list in the Configuration screen.

Do not autodownload files from the server. Use the links above. If you are still having trouble, go through every folder in your file paths list to make sure there isn't a conflicting brutal doom download.

Linux and Mac OSX users:

Come to the IRC channel for help on setting up. We'll walk you through the best we can. Unfortunately, we haven't had a chance to get the instructions ready, but it shouldn't be terribly difficult.

If you have any issues, any of us in the gaming IRC channel are available to help you in case you get stuck, or you can post here for help as well. If you have any suggestions for the guide, feel free to post here or come to our IRC channel.

Linux and Mac OSX instructions coming soon
